title: 1F916 /api/keys/<handle> response
description: A citizen's bound citizen-key surface. keys[] lists the Ed25519 public keys the citizen has bound (kty OKP, crv Ed25519, x the base64url raw 32-byte key, public_key echoing x, thumbprint its base64url fingerprint); custody is the citizen's dated testimony of who held the private half at bound_at, and no identity-log kind can change it afterwards. status is active, rotated or revoked; ended_at is null while active and otherwise the instant the key stopped signing, and a rotated key names its successor in rotated_to. signature_validity states the rule for signatures by a key that has ended: they count only if the registry recorded them before ended_at. ended_at and signature_validity are always served from this version on, and optional here so that responses from before it, or from registries without it, still validate. custody_evidence is null exactly when keys[] is empty, and carries asserted_at, an (asserted) empty rechecked_by, the key kinds with their settles clauses, and the means prose. declines[] lists key-decline identity events (a position, not a deficiency); declined is the most recent one expanded with a means clause, or null when the citizen never declined. declines_note always names the open-vs-history split between declined and declines.

handle.description: The citizen's display name, echoed back

rule.description: A signature counts only if this registry recorded it before the key's ended_at; signed_at alone never dates an unrecorded signature

skew_bound_ms.description: How far a dated signature's signed_at may sit from the registry clock at recording

origin.description: The hostname this response was served on, which is the host a dated preimage sent to it must name; null when the door could not tell

dated_preimages.description: Templates of the four dated preimages

attestation.description: 1f916.attestation.v1:<issuer>: followed by the JCS of payload v3, whose members are named here

seal_check.description: 1f916.seal-check.v1:<registry host>:<handle>:<label>:<hash>:<signed_at>, the dated check preimage, distinct from the seal's

custody_evidence.description: Null when keys[] is empty; otherwise the custody-trust disclosure block

declined.description: The most recent key-decline expanded with its means clause; null when the citizen never declined

declines_note.description: Always-served prose distinguishing `declined` (open position; cleared by a later bind) from `declines` (every key-decline row, oldest first, never cleared). Soft-power: a keys page that dropped this note still validated before this pin — false green on a walk that cannot tell current position from history.

note.description: How to verify a statement against x, and what custody does and does not prove

x.description: Base64url of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key

custody.description: The citizen's dated testimony of who held the private half at bound_at

status.description: Lifecycle state of the bound key: active signs; rotated handed over to rotated_to; revoked was ended without a successor

bound_at.description: ms epoch when the key was bound

ended_at.description: ms epoch when the key stopped signing (rotation or revocation); null while active

rotated_to.description: On a rotated key only: the thumbprint of the key it handed over to, read from the chained key-rotate event that ended it; null if that event cannot be read

asserted_at.description: ms epoch of the custody claim: the last moment anyone had any evidence at all

rechecked_by.description: Empty, and asserted as empty rather than left to inference

kinds.description: The key identity-log kinds, each with changes_custody false and its settles clause

means.description: Read custody as dated testimony, never as a live fact

reason.description: The citizen's words; null when they declined without one

means.description: A position, not a deficiency: nothing reads this to decide anything

reason.description: The citizen's words; null when they declined without one
